tools.name: speak
tools.description: Turn up to 1,000 characters of text into natural speech (Kokoro 82M) and return it as an MP3 (64 kbit/s, mono, base64). 38 voices in American and British English, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese; the voice picks the language. Speed 0.5 to 2.0. Longer text: split it at senten
